thread:
Owen: Morning — handing off kernel queueing work. Quick status: queue sharding patch landed, microbatch bench script done. Blocker: one flaky test in microbatch slot allocator. Today: wrap test fixes, push canary, run KV eviction metrics.

Tess: Nice. can you drop the bench numbers here when you have them? also, is prefetch still off in canary?

Owen: quick numbers from local run: 512-token, batch=16 -> p99 110ms -> 96ms, avg throughput +12%. command I used: `./bench.sh --env=canary --batch=16 --seq=512`

Ben: saw that flaky test earlier — looks like a race on slot free. opened PR #4321 with a repro and a tentative fix. cc @Sanjay

Sanjay: I can take the test tonight. will add a stricter assert and run the nightly bench with eviction on/off.

Tess: recommend we enable prefix cache on canary for one sweep too, to compare end-to-end. also fyi deploy-bot flagged canary quota for kernel-canary-4.

deploy-bot: deploy request: canary-channel -> kernel-canary-4 queued. ETA: ~12m.

Owen: ack. leaving a runbook note: if p99 regresses >+10% auto-fallback to the quantized variant (policy 3).

Ben: quick CR ping @Owen — I left comments around the slot free path and a couple of nits in allocator.cc.

Owen: addressed most comments, pushed another commit. added a bench flag `--eviction-window=60` so we can vary eviction during runs.

Tess: :thumbsup: I'll kick off a short perf sweep after the deploy and paste aggregated numbers here.

Sanjay: if my patch doesn't fully stabilize the flaky test, we may need a micro-delay in the allocator hot path as a stopgap. will report back with a timeline.

Owen: posting failing log excerpt for context: ```AssertionError: slot not free
at allocator.cc:142
Backtrace: allocator::free -> slot_manager::release -> test_runner::step```

Ben: thanks, that log matches what I saw. if Sanjay can't reproduce locally I'll add a deterministic stress harness.

Owen: plan for today: 1) merge test fix from Ben/PR -> stabilize CI; 2) push canary and run two bench sweeps (prefix cache on/off); 3) collect KV eviction metrics and share a short summary. will update this thread when numbers are in.

Tess: great. ping in here when the canary is live and I'll run the RL perf checks.

deploy-bot: kernel-canary-4 deployed to canary-channel — healthchecks green.

Owen: live — starting sweep now. will paste numbers in ~20m.

Tess: standing by. thanks everyone. :coffee:
